data.text:
Vijay Trimbak Kendre vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another
on 19 August, 2024 
Author: Shivkumar Dige
Bench: Shivkumar Dige
 1 30 aba.1411.24
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Bench At Aurangabad.
 30 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1411 Of 2024 
 Vijay Trimbak Kendre
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Rahul R. Karpe. 
 App for Respondent/State : Mr. P. K. Lakhotiya. 
 ... 
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 19th August, 2024. 
 P.C.: 
 . Heard. 
 2 Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 30 th August, 2024. 
The learned APP waives notice on behalf of both the respondents. 
3 In the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No.301 of 2024, registered with Umerga Police Station, Taluka Umerga, District Dharashiv, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv),
27(3)(e), 30(2) and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, he be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co- operate in the investigation.
